[[File:BUseriesBartenderDroid-FFp46.png|thumb|right|250px|A BU-series bartender droid]]
The '''BU-series bartender droid''' was a variant of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]'s [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] that was designed specifically for use as a [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]]. [[BU-11/Legends|BU-11]] was one such unit.

[[Unidentified BU-series droid bartender/Legends|Another unit]] worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
